components.name: Primary Pill
components.css: .ds-pill-primary { min-height:42px; border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:0 22px; background:#000; color:#fff; font:800 .86rem ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; transition:background-color 160ms,transform 160ms; } .ds-pill-primary:hover{background:#2c2c2c}.ds-pill-primary:active{transform:scale(.96)}.ds-pill-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #3346c4;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Outlined Pill
components.description: White secondary action with black inset outline.
components.css: .ds-pill-outline { min-height:42px; border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:0 22px; background:#fff; color:#000; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px #000; font:800 .86rem ui-sans-serif,sans-serif; transition:background-color 160ms,transform 160ms; }.ds-pill-outline:hover{background:#f5f5f5}.ds-pill-outline:active{transform:scale(.96)}.ds-pill-outline:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #3346c4;outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: A white engineering presentation board with oversized black type, capsule actions, large softly colored evidence blocks, and real product UI insets.

rules.name: The Field Color Rule
rules.body: Color owns a complete evidence block; do not scatter decorative accents across the canvas.

rules.name: The Scale Does the Selling Rule
rules.body: Keep language factual and create energy through size and line breaks.

dos: Do match the approved Variant composition.
Do use oversized black statements on white.
Do replace placeholders with real evidence.
donts: Don't use the rejected dark split-screen hero.
Don't replace rounded blocks with sharp editorial rows.
